title: I won't buy again 🤷🏾‍♀️
text: I won't buy again 🤷🏾‍♀️. They're cheap and you get a cheap product. I'm not pleased at all. A couple caps came with the nozzle bent. A few others leaked badly tho the cap was secure. There's also a drip from the tip of the nozzle when trying to stop your pour. If you're not concerned about a clean up, they're fine. If you need them to be secure, go with a different company. Good luck.
